# Live-002 selection evidence subset

Copied byte-for-byte from `run_16af3a6652f9422385483d6d4c4ffc2f` after it stopped with 10 model calls, 82175 tokens and zero ORCA starts. `manifest.json` records original file sizes/hashes and the five `select_conditions` replies in `run.model_records` order. The original Run remains unchanged.

This subset contains the immutable normalized Request decision, original control/permission/budget/configuration snapshots, Run history, four real retrieved knowledge Results and five real model response records. It omits unrelated HTTP request envelopes and report files. Tests copy these exact files into a temporary Store, reject the original parameters with precise feedback, then separately exercise a test-authored exact quotation. That positive test is an offline source-validation check, not model success, a method recommendation, ORCA execution or scientific qualification.
